findings.description: filename from the request URL is joined to UPLOAD_DIR without sanitizing. An absolute path or '..' segments escape the upload directory.
findings.scenario: filename='/etc/passwd' (os.path.join discards UPLOAD_DIR) or '../../../etc/shadow' reads arbitrary files.
findings.fix: Use os.path.basename(filename), or resolve with realpath and verify the result is inside UPLOAD_DIR.

findings.description: The lock is acquired and released manually. If open() or write() raises (disk full, permission error), the lock is never released and all later uploads deadlock.
findings.scenario: One save_upload hits ENOSPC; every later call blocks forever on acquire().

findings.description: path is interpolated into a shell command string with shell=True, so shell metacharacters in the path are executed.
findings.scenario: An uploaded file named 'a; rm -rf /srv/app' (or one with $(...) in the name) runs arbitrary commands.
